subject: Co-hosted demo series + MDF proposal (BrightLane)
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@brightlane.co>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership idea — 3-part demo series in Q3

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well. I manage strategic partnerships at BrightLane — we met quickly at DataSummit last year. Our product team is planning a three-part customer demo series in July–September focused on observability for LLMs and cost optimization.

BrightLane is interested in co-hosting with Redwood: joint promotion, a shared registration page, and split speaker slots (one of our engineers + one of your PMs). We have modest MDF we can allocate and would also like to explore a combined booth for an upcoming industry roadshow if this goes well.

Would you be open to a short call to align on format, dates, and MDF? Suggested dates: 7/14, 8/11, 9/8 (all Wednesdays).

Thanks — happy to loop in our events lead if you want to discuss ops and legal.

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Partnerships, BrightLane Analytics
olivia@brightlane.co

Attachment: BrightLane_demo_series_outline.pdf (1 page)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@brightlane.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership idea — 3-part demo series in Q3

Hi Olivia — great to hear from you and yes, congrats on the product momentum. I’m interested.

High-level: Redwood can commit speakers and a co-branded landing page. For MDF, we typically look for a 60/40 split (partner/redwood) or specific lead guarantees tied to spend. Before a call, could you share a rough MDF amount and the goals (registrations vs. MQLs)? That will help me bring the right folks.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (field/events) who will own ops and partner budgeting. If the booth is a possibility, loop in Ben from partnerships for commercial terms.

I’m available 4/15 or 4/16 for a 30-min sync.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0194
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Partnership idea — 3-part demo series in Q3

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Olivia’s note. Can you two take a look at ops and MDF feasibility? Quick asks:
- Marissa: are the suggested Wed dates (7/14, 8/11, 9/8) OK for Redwood events calendar? Any major conflicts with other roadshows or product launches?
- Ben: if BrightLane can commit an MDF number, what will we need contractually (SOW vs simple MAP)? Also thinking about a combined booth for the Northeast roadshow in September — do we treat that as separate negotiation?

Attachment: BrightLane_demo_series_outline.pdf

I’ll be on the 4/15 call (tentative).

—Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-15T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partnership idea — 3-part demo series in Q3

Thanks for the heads up. Quick operational notes:
- July 14: conflicts with a customer advisory board offsite (we’ll need backup hosts).
- Aug 11: open.
- Sept 8: potential conflict with the NYC roadshow booth prep week (but the week of the 8th is OK if we push booth load-in earlier).

For MDF: we run a standard MAP (mutual action plan) and use a cost-split workbook for promo spend. I attached a template of how we split digital ads, email sends, and co-branded content. If BrightLane’s MDF is under $15k, we can do a light MAP; above that we’ll need a short SOW and procurement ticket.

Attachment: Redwood_Event_Cost_Split.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Director | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partnership idea — 3-part demo series in Q3

Jonas / Marissa — my quick take:
- Commercially fine with a MAP if total MDF <= $25k across the series. Above that, we should route to procurement and get a short SOW.
- For the combined booth on the Sep roadshow: propose a 50/50 split on booth space + shared staffing costs, with a simple escalation clause if either party needs extra lead gen support.
- We’ll need to lock speakers and comms calendar 6 weeks prior to each session for promo.

I’ll craft a 1-page MAP draft and send to Olivia on 4/19 after your approval.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@brightlane.co>, BrightLane Partnerships <partnerships@brightlane.co>

Date: 2026-04-19T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood x BrightLane — MAP proposal and calendar

Olivia — thanks for the initial ask and for being flexible on dates. Attached is our draft MAP and the proposed cost-split worksheet. Quick summary:
- Dates: Series on 8/11, 9/8, 10/13 (moved July session to Oct to avoid conflicts)
- MDF: BrightLane commit $18,000 across the series; Redwood commits $12,000 (60/40 partner/redwood split)
- Promo: shared landing page, 3 co-branded emails (one per session), and a joint paid social push (split as in the workbook)
- Booth: Sep roadshow (week of 9/6): 50/50 booth costs; each party provides 2 on-site reps per day
- Legal: simple SOW for MDF > $15k; procurement cycle expected ~2 weeks

Please review the attached PDF and the cost workbook. If this aligns, Olivia, can you confirm and I’ll send a DocuSign for the MAP/SOW?

Attachments: BrightLane_MAP_v1.pdf, Redwood_Event_Cost_Split.xlsx

Best,
